label: cross-drill consistency of out-of-fold attempt residuals; most drills occur once
formula: (MSB - MSW) / (MSB + (n0 - 1) * MSW), one-way random effects, players with >= 2 attempts
bootstrap_unit: players, with duplicate draws relabeled so a player is not pooled with himself
latent_between_note: The SD of receiver means includes estimation error. The latent between-receiver SD is sqrt(max(0, (MSB-MSW)/n0)).
repeatability_threshold: Not estimated. Comparable same-condition repeats are too few to support a detectable-change rule. The 0.3-yard practice statement is withdrawn.
